recognize_zh: CD20染色下，許多大小不一的B細胞（含大型免疫母細胞）呈強膜狀陽性，散在或成小群，與陰性小T細胞混雜，呈現連續大小譜系而非單一片狀，符合EBV驅動的反應性B免疫母細胞增生。
features: Numerous CD20-positive B cells with strong membranous staining
Positive cells range from intermediate to large, including immunoblast-sized cells with vesicular nuclei
Scattered and loosely clustered distribution among CD20-negative small lymphocytes
No diffuse monotonous sheets of large CD20-positive cells
describe_en: CD20 immunostain highlights many B cells with strong membranous staining, ranging from intermediate cells to large immunoblasts, distributed singly and in loose clusters among CD20-negative small lymphocytes. The positive cells do not form confluent sheets. The pattern supports an expanded, polymorphous activated B-cell population as seen in EBV reactivation; correlation with EBER ISH (positive in a spectrum of cell sizes) is recommended.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows confluent sheets of large CD20+ cells effacing the tissue, with light-chain restriction or clonal IGH rearrangement.
HRS cells are CD20-negative or only weakly/variably positive, whereas the large immunoblasts here are strongly CD20+.
THRLBCL has rare scattered large CD20+ cells without small B cells, while this field shows abundant CD20+ cells of varied size.
